message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, how does Alex’s warning of trouble affect the reassurance you intended? Which actual words support your reading, and what remains uncertain about his effect on her? Would thinking longer clarify that uncertainty better than trying a brief dialogue revision now; conversely, what missing decision would make that attempt premature? What evidence would justify your choice? Can you name your finding and chosen next intention concisely in English, then carry it out?
